assets.title: Ochre Single Wedge Wheel Chock
assets.description: Original S01/S06 static single wheel-chock prop: an ochre rising wedge has a real transverse X-through gripping aperture in its thick rear section; a separate dark continuous sole has seven shallow underside channels and eight finite flat bearing strips. Two named editable closed meshes, solid PBR materials, metre scale and source Z-up. Origin X=Y=Z=0 lies on the ground, centred across width; sole Y extents -0.170 to +0.160 m. Low tip faces -Y, rising wedge and grip face +Y. One reusable model; repeated placements do not add models. Existing delivery-van wheel dimensions are a separate fixed-size visual comparison only. No vehicle-fit, braking, anti-roll, friction, load, carrying ergonomics, physics or safety certification.
